$Comment: A spot a bar panel can sit at: the bottom-left, just below your own health and mana bars and
clear of the hotbar. Measured for the wide World panel: two columns wide, which leaves a skill
name room to be read and stops well short of the hotbar; pinned to the bottom edge, it grows
UPWARD as rows come up and fills each column from the bottom, so the bar already on screen
stays put when the next one opens above it. Three rows deep it reaches the mana bar; a fourth
overlaps it, which is fine for the moment a busy stretch lasts.
Position is a corner preset plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins (OffsetY here
is measured UP from the bottom). Columns and RowsPerColumn say how the rows spread out here.
Panels lists which panels offer this spot. LabelKey names it in the HUD settings.
To retune a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'BottomLeft' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-placements.json with only the leaves you want different.
